history.headline: Two short faster runs now sit where the huge Åre trail block used to be. The restart holds its top-end range, but weekly cadence and a fresh threshold reading are both still missing. Strength stays the quiet corner.
watch_items: Watch whether running settles into a repeating weekly cadence now that the restart is two runs deep but still unconfirmed as a rhythm.
Watch for a single sustained tempo effort — the threshold reading has now aged past the point where the base can be assumed to still map to it.
Watch whether strength moves from isolated singles into any kind of recurring slot, and whether the next lift captures HR.
Watch whether the short runs sharpen into distinct easy-vs-quality intents rather than staying in the mixed grey-zone drift.

history.headline: The two short runs back now sit several days cold, with no third to confirm cadence. Big Åre block still anchors the base. Strength and a fresh threshold read remain the open gaps.
watch_items: Watch whether a third run finally lands to confirm the restart as a rhythm rather than an isolated pair.
Watch for a sustained tempo effort to refresh the now-stale threshold number before assuming the old value still holds.
Watch whether strength returns to any recurring slot — it's now the single most degraded consistency signal in the picture.
Watch whether the short runs separate into clear easy-vs-quality intent instead of settling mid-zone.

history.headline: Five days cold since the last run — the restart pair never became a rhythm. The Åre block still carries the base. Strength and a fresh threshold read remain the two open gaps.
watch_items: Watch whether a run lands soon at all — the concern has shifted from "confirm cadence" to "restart the cadence" as the gap widens.
Watch for a single committed tempo effort to refresh the stale threshold rather than more mixed-intent short runs.
Watch whether strength reappears in any form — it remains the most degraded consistency signal and has no recent anchor at all.
Watch whether the next running block declares a clear direction (trail durability vs speed) or stays in transition limbo.

history.headline: Six days now without a run — the restart pair never took root. The Åre block still holds the base, but strength and a fresh threshold read remain untouched gaps.
watch_items: Watch whether any run lands at all this week — the gap has now stretched long enough that the priority is simply re-establishing contact, not cadence quality.
Watch whether strength reappears in any form — it's been the quiet corner for weeks and now has no recent anchor whatsoever.
Watch whether the next block finally picks a lane — trail durability or speed — rather than continuing to alternate without committing.
Watch for a clean sustained tempo effort, which is the one session type that would both refresh the stale threshold and fill the missing middle of the zone distribution.

history.headline: Still no run in a week — the restart pair never became a habit. The Åre block keeps the base intact, but strength and a fresh threshold read stay untouched. Priority remains simply re-establishing contact.
watch_items: Watch whether any run lands at all — the priority is still re-establishing contact, and a full week now makes that the single most important thing to observe.
Watch whether strength reappears in any form, since it has no recent anchor and both streaks have reset.
Watch whether a clean sustained tempo finally shows up — it's the one session that would refresh the stale threshold and fill the missing middle.
Watch whether the next block commits to a lane rather than continuing to alternate between long trail volume and short speed touches.
